name: Should I hire a garage door technician or a remodeling carpenter for frame repair?

mainEntity.name: Should I hire a garage door technician or a remodeling carpenter for frame repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: While both work on garage openings, their core specialties differ. Garage door installation companies specialize in mechanical systems, including tracks, torsion springs, rollers, and openers. A finish carpentry and remodeling contractor specializes in structural framing, rough carpentry, exterior trim, jamb reconstruction, drywall, and weather-tight sealing. If the wood opening itself is rotted, misaligned, or structurally compromised by an impact, hiring a finish carpentry contractor ensures the structural perimeter is plumb, square, and sealed before any mechanical adjustments occur.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hire a remodeling carpenter for rotted wood, structural jambs, and trim work, while mechanical components like tracks, springs, and openers require a door technician.
